paper_title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models

figures.caption: Verifying a student's solution to a physics problem. The model is able to correctly recognize all of the handwritten content and verify the reasoning.

figures.caption: Gemini models support interleaved sequences of text, image, audio, and video as inputs (illustrated by tokens of different colors in the input sequence).

figures.caption: Chain-of-Thought with uncertainty routing on MMLU.

figures.label: Figure 10
figures.note: chart-understanding example embedding 4 horizontal-bar panels (Our World in Data) plus a rendered markdown table
figures.caption: Solving a problem requiring multimodal chart understanding. The model has to read the text, understand the connections between different data points and reason over them.

figures.label: Figure 11
figures.caption: Answering a multimodal information-seeking query. The model is able to recognize the specific plant shown in the image and provide information about it.

figures.label: Figure 12
figures.caption: Generating interleaved text and images. The model is able to follow the instructions of generating a blog post with images closely related to the text.

figures.label: Figure 13
figures.caption: Solving a multimodal reasoning problem. The model is able to recognize shapes in the image, understand their properties and reason about the relationship between them.

figures.label: Figure 14
figures.caption: Solving a geometrical reasoning task. The model shows good understanding of the task and is able to provide meaningful reasoning steps despite slightly unclear instructions.

figures.label: Figure 15
figures.caption: Solving a puzzle using multimodal inputs. The model recognizes the objects in the images and identifies a commonality that connects the two objects.

figures.label: Figure 16
figures.caption: Identifying the objects in the image (the Empire State Building) and recognizing what those are even with small levels of visual distortion in the image.

figures.label: Figure 17
figures.caption: Explanation of humor in a meme. The model is showing the ability to not only describe what is happening in the image but also what it means.

figures.label: Figure 18
figures.note: example embeds a family-tree relationship diagram
figures.caption: Common-sense reasoning in images. The model is able to understand the relationships represented in the graphs and reason about them in a multilingual setting.

figures.label: Figure 19
figures.note: code listing plus rendered website screenshot
figures.caption: Writing code for a website based on user request. The model follows the instructions and requirements defined by the user and converts them to functioning code.

figures.label: Figure 20
figures.caption: Solving a calculus problem. The model is able to get a solution to a calculus problem with step-by-step explanation and correctly defined LaTeX equations.

figures.label: Figure 21
figures.note: response includes a rendered markdown table
figures.caption: Solving a multi-step math problem. The model is able to understand the task and generate a markdown table with correctly calculated values.

figures.label: Figure 22
figures.note: example embeds matplotlib subplots (3 line + 1 3D surface) plus 1 rendered output line chart
figures.caption: Multimodal reasoning capabilities applied to code generation. Gemini Ultra needs to perform inverse graphics task to infer the code that would have generated the plots.

figures.label: Figure 23
figures.caption: Video understanding and reasoning over the situation presented in the video. Here, we provide a video as input to the model together with a text prompt.
